dict.string: o8 uses your microphone for push-to-talk voice dictation.
o8 uses Apple Speech Recognition to turn your voice into text before polish runs.
o8 uses Accessibility to capture the global Fn hotkey and paste dictated text into the app you are working in.
Symon reads your calendar to answer "what's on my calendar" by voice.
Symon reads your reminders to answer "what's on my list" by voice.
